SELECT COUNT(*) AS Total_Schools
FROM schools_data_ext sde
INNER JOIN satscores_data_ext sse ON sde.C_D_S_Cod = sse.cds2
WHERE sde.Vir = 'F' AND sse.Avg_Scr_Mat > 400;

SELECT f.C_D_S_Cod
FROM frpm_data_ext f
GROUP BY f.C_D_S_Cod
HAVING SUM(f.Enr_K_12) > 500;

SELECT MAX(fre.Fre_Mea_Cou_Age_5_17 / fre.Enr_Age_5_17) AS Max_Eligible_Free_Rate
FROM satscores_data_ext sat
JOIN frpm_data_ext fre ON sat.cds2 = fre.C_D_S_Cod
WHERE sat.Num_G_E_150 * 1.0 / sat.Num_Tst_Tak > 0.3;
